title: Practice Updates
description: Keeping your device updated is important for safety, but bad actors often fake update screens. Look at the screens below. Decide if it is a real system update or a fake internet pop-up. You cannot break anything here!

challenges.message: ⚠️ WARNING! Your phone has a virus! It is severely damaged! You MUST click here to install an urgent update right now or lose all your photos!
challenges.justInTimeHint: Does this screen feel loud, flashing, and trying to rush you?

challenges.visualStyle: calm, clean, plain text on white or gray background
challenges.message: Software Update. A new update is available for your device. This update includes bug fixes and security improvements. It will take about 10 minutes to complete.
challenges.justInTimeHint: Notice how calm and simple this screen looks. It's just quietly waiting for you.

gentleFailureFakeInstall.title: A Wonderful Learning Experience!
gentleFailureFakeInstall.message: Rushing pop-ups are designed to make you act fast, but you have all the time in the world here. Real updates never flash; they are very polite. You are learning exactly what to look for, so let's try the next one!

gentleFailureRealIgnore.title: Great Instincts to be Careful!
gentleFailureRealIgnore.message: It is always a great choice to ignore something if you aren't sure! For the future, remember that real, safe updates live calmly in your 'Settings' app and are very polite. Installing them is a great way to keep your device secure. You're doing wonderfully!

success.title: Spot On!
success.message: You ignored the loud, rushing pop-up and correctly trusted the calm, polite system update. You are building excellent confidence with your device!
